sources.summary: Tbilisi Architecture Forum 2026 Announces "Places in Transition" Tbilisi, Georgia — Tbilisi Architecture Forum (TAF) 2026 will take place 18–20 September 2026, bringing together leading international and regional voices in architecture, design, urbanism, and culture for three days of dialogue, exchange, and exploration. Under the theme Places in Transition, TAF 2026 explores the evolving nature of our cities, landscapes, and communities. Places are never static. They are shaped by social change, technological innovation, climate challenges, shifting identities, conflict, development, and the continuous reinterpretation of heritage. Rather than focusing solely on creating something new, the forum asks how architecture can question, adapt, preserve, rebuild,
